items.summary: Papertrade称，Hyperliquid周末维护（通常在东亚时间周六下午）前最多60分钟起逐步下调杠杆与OI上限，post-only期结束前暂停交易；若链下价格偏离过大致系统性亏损，ETH或BTC市场可能被永久冻结预言机价格，持仓按冻结前BBO平仓，官方称预计不会触发。
items.author: papertrade_xyz
items.new_information: 维护前降杠杆与OI上限，极端情况下市场预言机价格永久冻结

evidence.quote: most weekends on hyperliquid see a small window of semi-scheduled maintenance, usually but not always saturday afternoon east asian time. these windows present systemic challenges to papertrade by consequence of hypercore block production briefly halting, and the short "post only" period across their books that follows.

due to this, there are two things to know. the first is that we will be progressively lowering the leverage and OI caps available on papertrade from up to 60 minutes before the window begins, and will not be processing any trades after the upgrade at all until such a time as the "post only" period is over, and we can confirm the books are live once more.

finally, since the oracle will remain stale for some of this period, should off-chain prices deviate too far from our last recorded mid price such that the exchange faces systemic losses on either our ETH or BTC markets, it is possible we may have to freeze one or both of the markets.

once frozen, a markets oracle price is locked, forever, and will stop updating with the hyperliquid books. traders with positions in such a market are free to close them out at their leisure at the last recorded BBO price before the freeze.
we do not anticipate this will ever be necessary to trigger, and we are working with the hyperliquid team in order to try and improve the experience during exchange downtime in the future.

items.summary: 0xDeployer在bankr上线首个指数代币MAG7：买入时Uniswap v4 hook买入7只股票代币并按背书价铸造MAG7，作者分成设0后0.5%费率中0.3%留在篮子归持有人，再平衡用荷兰拍并提前48小时通知。作者提醒其他池可能偏离背书价，高于背书价买入即多付；美英用户无法在bankr购买。
items.author: 0xDeployer
items.new_information: hook按背书价铸造、费用回流篮子，偏离池买入有溢价风险

evidence.quote: deployed MAG7 this evening, the first index on bankr: one token backed by a basket of up to 20 tokens. and on MAG7, the trading fees go to the holders.

every buy, a uniswap v4 hook buys all 7 stocks from their own pools and mints MAG7. every sell burns MAG7 and sells the basket. one transaction either way. the index itself needs no LP, so creators don’t need to provide liquidity to launch one. it’s already in the pools of the tokens it holds. this isn’t possible without uniswap hooks.

the fees: MAG7 charges 0.50% a trade. i set my creator cut to 0, so 0.30% of every buy and sell goes back into the basket for holders, and 0.20% to the protocol. nobody claims anything. it’s released into the basket over 24h, so after every trade each MAG7 is backed by a little more. creators pick a fee of 0.25–1% at launch and it never changes.

the index never market-sells when rebalancing. it runs dutch auctions, offering what it holds too much of at a price that starts good for holders and gets cheaper every minute until someone fills it. anyone can fill. every rebalance gets 48h notice, so holders can leave first.
buying MAG7 on bankr isn’t available in the US or UK.

a note if you’re speculating: MAG7 isn’t priced like a memecoin. its price is the value of the stocks it holds, shown live as "backing" on the bankr trade page. buying on bankr mints new MAG7 at that price, so buys don’t pump it. it moves with the 7 stocks. other pools can trade above or below the backing until arbs close the gap, and buying above it means
paying more than it’s backed by.

items.summary: 孙宇晨称Q-day或仅剩1–1.5年，拟把BTC转入从未签名的新地址作“掩体”。runes_leo指出这仅是预测，换址不等于抗量子，建议先审计UTXO公钥暴露与地址复用。
items.author: runes_leo
items.new_information: 新地址“掩体模式”，以及审计UTXO的反驳建议

evidence.quote: 但「Q-day 可能只剩 1–1.5 年」仍是预测，不是已有破解证据。
对于 BTC 持有者，我认为更实际的第一步是审计 UTXO：区分脚本类型、公钥是否已暴露、地址是否复用。
尤其不能把「转到新地址」直接等同于抗量子安全。
5. 他认为 Q-Day 可能已经是未来一到两年需要认真考虑的事情。 过去他保守估计还有两年，现在随着 AI 在数学能力上的进展，甚至开始考虑一年到一年半的可能性。他还提出一种更激进的担忧，未来未必需要等到成熟的量子计算机，经典计算方法的突破也可能威胁部分钱包安全。
8. 他的第一步应对方式不是卖币，而是改变资产存储方式。 他提出将 BTC 转移到从未对外签名、没有转出记录的新地址。每次需要动用资产时，再把剩余 BTC 转到新的地址。他将这种做法称为掩体模式，准备先对相关资产进行隔离，再观察技术进展决定是否减仓。

items.author: DAlperovitch
items.event: 中国拟管制开放权重模型出口
items.new_information: 拟议规则下，新发布的开放权重模型可能触发出口管制

evidence.quote: I’ve been saying it for a while - freely available Chinese open weight models that are near frontier aren’t long for this world. Will be surprised if there are any freely available within 18 months or less
Beijing just took a big step towards closing the Chinese frontier. The rules could give China's government the power to restrict AI developers from releasing their most advanced open-weight models.

It proposes banning exports of AI technologies that autonomously generate and modify malicious code. It also wants to restrict exports of AI-assisted vulnerability-discovery technologies. Giving a model away for free, ie open-weight, could qualify as an export.

Crucially, the rules distinguish between technologies already in the public domain and those not yet released. It specifically exempts existing open-source models. But new releases could potentially trigger export controls.

items.summary: IMF亚太部主任Krishna Srinivasan称，若通胀超出预期，日本央行可能需要更快加息。日本央行9月已将利率加至1.25%，为31年新高。PhyrexNi分析认为，日元套息交易去杠杆可能波及美股与BTC。

evidence.quote: 日本的加息节奏可能还会加快。今天 IMF 亚太部主任Krishna Srinivasan认为，日本央行推进货币政策正常化的方向是正确的，如果通胀超过预期，就可能需要更快加息，避免人们形成物价会持续更快上涨的预期。
日本央行9月已经把政策利率提高到1.25%，创31年新高，不少分析师预计年底前还会再加一次。

items.summary: Coinsph回应CoinDesk关于牌照可能被吊销的报道，称VASP与EMI牌照均有效。公司称菲律宾央行的限制仅涉及经InstaPay和PESONet向DCPay法币充值，加密交易与提现正常，同时承认央行要求其完善内控。
items.author: wublockchain12
items.new_information: 牌照有效，限制仅涉及法币充值

evidence.quote: 据菲律宾加密媒体 BitPinas 报道，针对 CoinDesk 此前关于 Coinsph 因涉嫌涉及离岸博彩交易而面临牌照吊销风险的报道，菲律宾加密交易平台 Coinsph 回应称，其旗下 Betur Inc. 的虚拟资产服务提供商（VASP）牌照及 DCPay Philippines 的电子货币发行（EMI）牌照目前均保持有效，并否认向违规离岸博彩运营商提供服务。Coinsph 表示，菲律宾央行的限制措施仅涉及通过 InstaPay 和 PESONet 向 DCPay 进行法币充值，加密货币交易、提现及其他支付服务仍正常运行。公司同时承认，央行已要求其完善内部控制措施，目前正配合监管要求。菲律宾央行则拒绝评论具体监管事项。https://t.co/eyizhkeH2M
